class.name: SoundConcurrencyManager
class.brief_description: Limits simultaneous voices per sound group.
class.description: Tracks [AudioStreamPlayer], [AudioStreamPlayer2D] and [AudioStreamPlayer3D] instances per named group. Call [method request_play] before playing a sound; if it returns [code]true[/code], start the player. Victims chosen by the group's [SoundConcurrency] rule are stopped automatically, and slots are released when the player emits [signal AudioStreamPlayer.finished]. The player's [code]volume_db[/code] is lowered according to [member SoundConcurrency.volume_scale] and restored when the slot is released.

method.name: clear_group_configs
method.description: Removes all per-group configurations (the default applies afterwards).

method.name: get_active_count
method.description: Returns the number of tracked voices in [param group].

method.name: get_group_config
method.description: Returns the configuration used for [param group] (the default when none was set).

method.name: has_group_config
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param group] has its own configuration.

method.name: release_player
method.description: Stops [param player] and frees its slot.

method.name: request_play
method.description: Asks to play [param player] in [param group]. [param position] is the sound's world position and [param listener] the listener position (used by the farthest rule). Returns [code]false[/code] when the sound was rejected by the retrigger interval or the group's resolution rule; otherwise stops victims if needed, registers the voice and returns [code]true[/code]. This method does not call [code]play()[/code].

method.name: set_group_config
method.description: Sets the configuration for [param group]. Passing [code]null[/code] removes it.

method.name: stop_all
method.description: Stops every tracked voice in every group.

method.name: stop_group
method.description: Stops every tracked voice in [param group].

members.member: Configuration used by groups without their own. Defaults to 8 voices, stop oldest.

signal.name: voice_stopped
signal.description: Emitted after the manager stopped [param player] (as a victim, or through [method release_player], [method stop_group] or [method stop_all]). Players that were stopped this way never emit [code]finished[/code], so connect here to free pooled or one-shot players.
